action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage over every legal White root move at depth 4 to identify the strongest and safest candidates.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search, so candidate_moves must be empty. Black's Rc3 attacks the e3 pawn and pressures the f3/c-file, and the b6 rook is en prise-adjacent. I need a full depth-4 sweep to find tactical refutations and the best reply before committing.
